provenance.source: PR #5808 fix(cookies): keep an Expires of 0 when serializing a cookie, squash-merged 2026-09-15 as 6933139ba
provenance.note: The PR replaced the truthiness test with a null test so a numeric 0 is no longer dropped, but it kept the string comparison, which only guards the Date form: a number outside the range a Date can represent is not caught, so toIMFDate reads NaN getters and splices undefined/NaN into the attribute. The base has the same out-of-range symptom (cookie.expires is truthy for 1e16 and 1e16.toString() is not 'Invalid Date' either), so the reviewed line is code the PR rewrote without repairing and the later fix #5832 rewrites it; the zero case the PR does repair behaves correctly at head.

bugs.note: the guard stringifies the value instead of testing its type, so a number no Date can represent reaches toIMFDate and the emitted attribute is garbage; the fix keeps the value out of the attribute unless it is a valid time value
